issue.title: Remove a lot of unnecessary Java type parameters

repository.name: nessie
repository.description: Nessie: Transactional Catalog for Data Lakes with Git-like semantics

issue.body:
Generics removed from:
* `StoreWorker`, uses `Content`, `Content.Type`, `CommitMeta` directly
* `VersionStore`, uses `Content`, `Content.Type`, `CommitMeta` directly
* `Commit`, uses `Content`, `CommitMeta` directly
* `Operation` + `Delete`/`Put`/`Unchanged`, uses `Content` directly
* `Diff`, uses `Content` directly
* `KeyEntry`, uses `Content.Type` directly

Changes to `Content` + `Content.Type`:
* `Content.Type` refactored to a "plain" Java interface
* Add ability to register `Content.Type`s via Java service-loader
  mechanism
* Updated custom `Content`/`Content.Type`/`CommitMeta` variants
  in `nessie-versioned-tests`, add a content-type bundle for these

Note: Weld/CDI extension for compatibility tests had to be updated
to allow (old) parameterized-type signature of `VersionStore` _and_
(new) non-parameterized-type signature.

This PR is split into two commits: one with the actual changes and another with the "boring stuff/changes" implied by the actual changes.

Follow-up PRs: #4942 #4943 #4944 #4945

Noteworthy changes in the follow-up PRs:
* `Content.Type.payload()` will be removed in a follow-up PR
* Many uses of `StoreWorker` will be eliminated

See issue #4940

issue.title: Jackson: also detect class referenced by `@JsonTypeIdResolver`
issue.body:
Adds missing support for classes referenced by `@JsonTypeIdResolver`, which is particularly important when using native builds.

The added integration tests are likely only meaningful when run in native mode (`-Pnative`), otherwise "good old Java reflection" does its job.

Fixes #27346
